_doc: Unified source registry for the 5 non-news/non-courses streams per CHITTI_NEWS_AI_MASTER_SPEC v0.3 §3 + §7. One JSON file, one stream per top-level key (cert / tool / job / scheme / roadmap_node). Each source has the same shape as courses_sources.json — type (json/rss/static_manifest), default_professions, url_patterns, manifest. The generic ingestor at services/streams_ingestor.py walks every key, ingests via the matching transport, and persists into the aggregated_items table with kind=<key>.
